Subraveti, S.G., Rodriguez Angel, E., Ramirez, A. and Roussanaly, S. (2023). Supporting Information for: Is Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) Really So Expensive? An Analysis of Cascading Costs and CO2 Emissions Reduction of Industrial CCS Implementation on the Construction of a Bridge. Environmental Science & Technology 57(6), 2595-2601. doi:10.1021/acs.est.2c05724 (file es2c05724_si_001.pdf, 12 pages, Tables S1-S12)

NO NEW TECHNOLOGY-LEVEL NUMBERS. The SI documents the bridge value-chain calculation. Plant-level data are all taken from held, extracted sources: cement plant without/with CCS (oxy-fuel; CO2 generated 626/649, captured 584, emitted 65 kgCO2/t cement, 90% avoided; electricity 0.097/0.207 MWh/t cement; CAPEX 16/27 and fixed OPEX 14/20 EUR2018/t cement; avoided cost 53, capture cost 51 EUR2018/tCO2) from Gardarsdottir et al. 2019 (CEMCAP; gardarsdottir_2019_001); steel plant without/with CCS (CO2 generated 2090/1976, captured 861, emitted 1115 kgCO2/t HRC, 47% avoided; coal 0.67/0.55 t/t HRC, natural gas 0.849/5.045 GJ/t HRC; CAPEX 110/132 and fixed OPEX 102/108 EUR2018/t HRC; avoided cost 55 EUR2018/tCO2) from IEAGHG 2013/04 (ieaghg_2013_003). The only transformation is CEPCI escalation of CAPEX and fixed OPEX to EUR2018 and repricing of coal, iron ore, gas and electricity at 2018 prices (coal 90.8 EUR/t, iron ore 59.1 EUR/t, natural gas 6.5 EUR/GJ, electricity 62 EUR/MWh, CO2 transport and storage 10 EUR/t). Other numbers are value-chain items with no technology home: upstream emission factors (Tanzer 2022), HRC-to-steel conversion 300 kgCO2/t (Rootzen and Johnsson 2016), concrete mix and costs (Rootzen and Johnsson 2017), truck transport 0.084 kgCO2/tkm and 0.04 EUR2018/tkm, bridge cost shares (Kim et al. 2009), total production costs cement 49/78 EUR2018/t, HRC 422/475 EUR2018/t, structural steel 519/572 EUR2018/t, concrete 124/134 EUR2018/m3. Answers the to-get row 'Subraveti et al. 2023 supporting information': the detailed numbers behind the cascade are reprinted escalations of held sources, so the row can be closed.
